p1_a_paired_provider_authority_forwardin.observed_condition: When PairedAcquisitionCoordinator.admit_paired(provider_batch=...) received valid authorization and admission, its _context_unit constructed ProviderAcquisition(ctx_cap, core=..., operational=...) without forwarding authorization or admission. This caused _open_context to fail with AdmissionRefused('PERMISSION_DENIED'), leaving Core committed and Context rejected.
p1_a_paired_provider_authority_forwardin.root_cause: src/repo_catalog/application/acquisition.py:2003 constructed ProviderAcquisition without authorization=self.authorization, admission=self.admission, and Context.for_transaction did not receive authorization/admission binding parameters.
p1_a_paired_provider_authority_forwardin.remediation: Forwarded self.authorization and self.admission into Context.for_transaction and into ProviderAcquisition in both admit_paired and reconcile_core_dependencies. The same trusted, validated service-issued authority now reaches every nested Context operation.

p1_b_exchange_finite_grants_and_fallback.observed_condition: When a receiver supplied permitted_repository_uuidv4s but omitted authorization/admission, the fallback constructed LocalAuthorizationPolicy with grants=None, which unconditionally denied resource dependencies. Furthermore, if Core committed before Context evaluated resource admission, Core could commit while Context failed.
p1_b_exchange_finite_grants_and_fallback.root_cause: src/repo_catalog/application/exchange.py:1798 and 1885 invoked create_local_admission_service without grants; _import_package lacked grants propagation and pre-transaction receiver authority validation.
p1_b_exchange_finite_grants_and_fallback.remediation: Added explicit grants parameter to ExchangeService.__init__ and import_package. Added _validate_receiver_authority preflight check before coordinator.admit and before Context.transaction. Permitted repository without finite resource grant fails closed immediately with typed PERMISSION_DENIED and zero database writes. When receiver supplies finite grants, Resource imports succeed in both Core+Context and Context-only receivers.

p2_selection_admission_behavioral_execut.observed_condition: test_receiver_empty_selection_admits_zero_resources and test_receiver_selective_subset_omits_unselected_sender_resources only constructed ExchangePackage and ExchangeSelectionScope without calling import_package, inspecting database state, or observing policy leases.
p2_selection_admission_behavioral_execut.root_cause: Non-behavioral assertions that did not execute real admission paths.
p2_selection_admission_behavioral_execut.remediation: Replaced both tests with full end-to-end integration tests using genuine SQLite sender and receiver stores, export_package, import_package, SQLite database row inspections, and policy call observations confirming exact subset admission and zero unselected admission.

p1_complete_dependency_set_prevalidation.observed_condition: For a Core+Context package containing a resource and its Provider registration, grants covering the resource and repository but omitting provider_registrations passed preflight. The same happened when the repository was permitted but absent from grants.repositories. PairCoordinator committed Core before Context unit rejected the missing grant, resulting in partial Core writes.
p1_complete_dependency_set_prevalidation.root_cause: Prevalidation only checked resource/source subsets against policy grants rather than extracting and validating the complete dependency set across all dimensions before entering the coordinator.
p1_complete_dependency_set_prevalidation.remediation: Implemented ExchangeService._extract_context_dependencies to extract resources, repositories, sources, source_repository_pairs, provider_registrations, dispositions, mapping_claims, and object_oids, and validated the complete dependency set before entering coordinator.admit or Context.transaction.

p2_supported_authorization_policy_interf.observed_condition: When a receiver supplied ContextAdmissionService backed by a custom AuthorizationPolicy (such as FixturePolicy), preflight raised AttributeError on _principal or _permitted_repositories.
p2_supported_authorization_policy_interf.root_cause: Prevalidation inspected internal LocalAuthorizationPolicy attributes (_principal, _permitted_repositories) instead of adhering to the public AuthorizationPolicy protocol.
p2_supported_authorization_policy_interf.remediation: Replaced internal attribute accesses with the public AuthorizationPolicy.lease() protocol method and validated through the policy lease context manager, allowing any valid AuthorizationPolicy implementation to execute cleanly.

p1_sqlite_safety_guard_bypass.observed_condition: An autouse pytest fixture `_patch_sqlite_version` in `test_i6c_authority_and_exchange.py` monkeypatched `p1_schema.sqlite3.sqlite_version_info` and `sqlite3.sqlite_version_info` to `(3, 51, 3)`, which bypassed the production WAL safety guard and violated ADR 0032.
p1_sqlite_safety_guard_bypass.root_cause: Unnecessary fixture monkeypatching `sqlite_version_info` rather than testing with the actual execution environment's SQLite engine.
p1_sqlite_safety_guard_bypass.remediation: Removed the `_patch_sqlite_version` fixture and unused `p1_schema` import from `tests/integration/i6/test_i6c_authority_and_exchange.py`. All 40 integration tests now execute against the real runtime SQLite engine (SQLite 3.53.1) without version spoofing, conforming strictly to ADR 0032.

p2_mapping_claim_support_grants.observed_condition: For test_mapping_claim_support_and_dispositions_are_exact, generated grants omitted mapping claims embedded in relation mapping support provenance because _extract_context_dependencies did not populate mapping_claims from decoded relations/dispositions.
p2_mapping_claim_support_grants.root_cause: _extract_context_dependencies initialized mapping_claims to an empty set but never populated it from decoded relations and dispositions, and test_selective_exchange.py did not pass explicit receiver grants covering mapping support.
p2_mapping_claim_support_grants.remediation: Populated mapping_claims and dispositions in ExchangeService._extract_context_dependencies via dependencies(rel) and dependencies(disp). Updated receive and test_mapping_claim_support_and_dispositions_are_exact in tests/integration/i3/test_selective_exchange.py to supply explicit receiver-owned fixture grants covering mapping support.
